senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; preced.) argument, plea; decision, judgment.
units: Snh. 111ᵇ (ref. to פליליה, Is. XXVIII, 7) אין פ׳ אלא דיינים p’lilah means the verdict of judges; Yalk. Is. 302; Meg. 15ᵇ, v. next w.—Pl. פְּלִילוֹת.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 44a:14">Snh. 44ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>ויפלל</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 106:30">Ps. CVI, 30</cite>) <he>עשה פ׳ עם קונו</he> he pleaded with his Maker; ib. 82ᵇ; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 865:4">Yalk. Ps. 865</cite>; a. e.
